What is a "new subscriber"?
A "new subscriber" refers to a user who subscribes to the Trae Pro plan for the first time and is eligible for a limited-time discounted price. To ensure fair use of this discount, we may reasonably assess eligibility based on factors such as device usage history, payment behavior, and refund records. Users who do not meet the criteria may not be eligible for the new subscriber offer.
